turnout.notes: Delaware turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. DOE AGP registered/voted rows are retained as a state-native reconciliation lead but are not active turnout because AGP voted and registration totals differ from EAC fallback semantics.

reviewCharts.warning: Delaware review rows are election-district President versus U.S. Senate comparisons from the official DOE report. County labels come from the official AGP report; election-district geometry/crosswalks are not loaded.

historicalBaselines.warning: Delaware historical baseline rows are official 2020 county-level presidential context from the DOE General Election Results Report. Use them as baseline context only, not as 2024 certified data.
